ftp.label: 255W
ftp.note: Reference power only — the plan explicitly does not treat FTP as a hard gate. Race readiness is judged primarily by 22km TT time, sustainable aero power, and brick performance.

vo2.label: 62 mL/kg/min
vo2.note: User-set target for race day, age 41. Published data for amateur Olympic-distance triathletes (mean age 42.1y) shows measured VO2max 54.0±5.1 mL/kg/min, and general fitness-chart guidance puts trained men in their 40s at ~48–55+ mL/kg/min ‘good-to-excellent’; 62 sits above that band as a stretch target.

bodyweight.label: 155 lb
bodyweight.note: Per plan §17, body weight is treated as a dependent variable, not a hard requirement — shown here as a personal target only.
